How OCR Developers Can Help You

<01>

Automated Data Extraction Services

An OCR engineer will transform the way you manage your business data and run your business by introducing automated data extraction from scanned papers, PDFs, and images. These services scan and turn them into editable and searchable text, simplifying data entry, improving accuracy and saving time. This is especially useful for businesses like banks, hospitals and law firms that have a lot of paperwork.

<02>

Archive Scanning Services

OCR archive scanning will turn the historical records into readable digital copies. This keeps valuable historical documents safe and makes them easy for searching and sharing of the information. OCR development is necessary for libraries, universities, government agencies, and other organizations aimed at preserving valuable data and making it more practical for everyday use, research, or education.

<03>

Document Digitization Services

OCR companies are capable of converting paper documents into digital form. It is a significant stage in the transition of companies towards a paperless workplace, which helps in preserving data and security. Digitization decreases physical space volumes, enhances the speed of document retrieval and facilitates the integration of the data into electronic handling systems, thus gradually replacing the traditional paperwork culture.

<04>

Handwriting Recognition

The OCR handwriting recognition technology is capable of the conversion of handwritten notes into digital text. This is very beneficial for areas like healthcare and law, where written notes are very common. OCR allows inclusion of them into digital records ensuring that the data is complete and accessible. This also empowers analytics and search capabilities.

<05>

Number Plate Recognition

A developer with OCR experience can build number plate recognition systems that would automatically capture and log vehicle license plates from photos or video streams. This technology greatly helps manage traffic, security, and toll collection systems. It allows for collecting data about the movement of each vehicle, enforcing the speed limits and automating the billing processes, ensuring smooth operations.

<06>

Assistive Technology

OCR technology greatly contributes to the design of assistive devices for people with visual impairments. Using software to read text out loud or translate it into Braille, OCR developers can create tools that help to greatly increase access to written materials for those with special needs. OCR gives confidence and autonomy, enabling them to read books, order from menus, and access printed information without the need for assistance.

FAQs on Hiring OCR Developers

Do you offer assistance with the OCR developer technical interview?

Certainly, we deliver total help during the hiring process. Our service includes the input of a team of experienced developers in OCR who are experts in analyzing the technical and skill levels of candidates suitable for your particular project. Our assistance in OCR developer technical interview will enable you to make well-informed choices and help you pick programmers who meet the project requirements and goals.

What are the costs associated with hiring an OCR developer, and what pricing models do you offer?

Pricing and engagement process designed to reflect your specific requirements and intended project outcomes. We provide flexible pricing so you can select the most appropriate solution for you. Our approach relies on the use of cost-control measures to ensure efficient collaboration from the very beginning to the end.

Is it possible to work with an OCR developer on an as-needed or project basis?

Yes, you can. We possess flexible options to meet your demand whether you opt for an hourly payment or by phases of the project. This ability allows you to change the number of staff as your project’s demands vary, ensuring there is always the appropriate support for you.

Can I expect OCR developers to begin working on my project in a reasonable amount of time?

For your OCR developer or one dedicated team, we will start your project within three weeks. We have a quick recruitment process for speed. The exact time frame may differ based on the specific skill set and level of experience required, but we guarantee to meet your demands within the shortest time possible.

What measures will you take to ensure that my intellectual property is protected?

The protection of your intellectual property is our number one priority from the very beginning. An NDA is signed at the start of the project to ensure your interests are protected. Our Master Service Agreements (MSAs) are holistic covering all the aspects of IP protection and we make sure that you maintain exclusive ownership of the project outcomes. Moreover, we use secure communication for the confidentiality of your project information.

Can I change the developers’ level of experience, where they’re located, or what they know technically?

Our terms of engagement allow us to seamlessly adjust to your full project scope. Whether you need to change the developers’ experience level, geographical location, or technical skill set, we will react immediately to your request. You pay only for the work of the developer, all changes are free of charge.
